privacy.coreBody: Your uploaded images and generated vector files are temporarily saved solely for user convenience, enabling interactive previews, parameter adjustments, and instant downloads during your active workflow.
privacy.coreStrong: Your data is never used for any secondary purposes, is never used to train AI models, and remains strictly confidential and private.
privacy.coreTitle: Core Principle: Data is Temporarily Saved for Convenience & Remains Private
privacy.lastRevised: Last revised: November 2026 • Effective immediately for all visitors and registered users.
privacy.liCredsBody: If you sign in via Google Sign-In or email/password authentication, your user identifier (UID), email address, and profile name are securely stored via Google Firebase Authentication.
privacy.liFingerprintBody: To prevent promo-credit abuse, a device fingerprint identifier (generated locally by FingerprintJS from browser characteristics) and its association with granted accounts are stored server-side. It is used solely for anti-fraud checks and is never used for tracking or advertising.
privacy.liHistoryA: If you choose to save vector results to your history while signed in, compressed SVG paths and metadata are stored in your private Firestore record (
privacy.liHistoryB: , grouped per source image with a
privacy.liHistoryC: subcollection) protected by security rules allowing only you to access them.
privacy.liPaymentBody: When purchasing credit packs via cryptocurrency, public on-chain identifiers (transaction hash, blockchain network, credit amount, timestamp) are recorded to automatically credit your balance upon block confirmation.
privacy.liSecurityBody: We use Firebase App Check and reCAPTCHA Enterprise tokens to protect the service from automated bot attacks and denial-of-service abuse.
privacy.s1Body: When you upload an image to Vectorizerr, your file and generated vector assets are temporarily saved exclusively to support real-time canvas viewing, comparison sliders, and format downloads. This temporary storage exists purely for your convenience as you work. We do not inspect, monetize, or repurpose your image content for any other objective.
privacy.s1Title: 1. Temporary Storage for Convenience & Workflow Continuity
privacy.s2Body: We uphold a strict standard of non-exploitation. Your visual assets and designs are never used to train machine learning models, are never commercialized or licensed to external parties, and are never shared with advertising networks. Your intellectual property remains exclusively yours.
privacy.s2Title: 2. Zero Secondary Use & No AI Training
privacy.s3Intro: We collect only the essential operational data necessary to manage account authentication, credit quotas, and transaction confirmations:
privacy.s4Body: Cryptocurrency transactions conducted on public blockchains (Ethereum, BNB Smart Chain, Polygon, Base, Arbitrum, Bitcoin) are immutable and publicly visible on decentralized ledgers. Vectorizerr does not custody your private keys or have access to your wallet funds. All transactions are signed by your own Web3 wallet provider (e.g. MetaMask, Coinbase Wallet, WalletConnect).
privacy.s5Body: Vectorizerr protects credit transactions and generation quotas with a server-side Cryptographic Handshake system. Generation tickets are signed using HMAC-SHA256 algorithms and attested against Google App Check JWKS keys. This safeguards the integrity of credits and prevents unauthorized manipulation.
privacy.s6Body: You maintain total ownership and control over your content. You may delete individual items from your vectorization history at any time through the in-app History Drawer. If you wish to delete your entire account and associated Firestore data, you can submit a request through our Support Portal.
privacy.s7Prefix: If you have inquiries or requests regarding our privacy practices or data confidentiality guarantees, please contact our assistance team through our support portal at
privacy.title: Privacy Policy

terms.s1Body: By accessing Vectorizerr at vectorizerr.pages.dev or associated endpoints, you agree to comply with and be bound by these Conditions of Use and our Privacy Policy. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use the application.
terms.s2CreditsBody: Exporting raw, scalable, lossless SVG files requires credits or an active plan. Unlocking an image with 1 credit grants a quota of up to {count} validated vector generations on that image, allowing you to fine-tune presets and parameters without redundant charges.
terms.s2FreeBody: High-resolution vectorization preview, split-screen comparison, and exports to PNG or WebP formats are completely free and do not require user login or credit consumption.

terms.s3GasBody: Blockchain gas/network fees are paid directly to network validators and are non-refundable. Vectorizerr does not control network congestion or gas price fluctuations.

terms.s3NonRefundableBody: Cryptocurrency top-ups represent final, non-refundable purchases of platform execution credits used exclusively for vector processing. Credits are non-transferable, cannot be withdrawn back to external wallets, and carry no monetary store-of-value.
terms.s3OnchainBody: Transactions are processed on public decentralized blockchains (BNB Smart Chain, Ethereum, Polygon, Base, Arbitrum, Bitcoin). Credits are credited to your account once the transaction attains the required on-chain block confirmations.
terms.s3TrackingBody: Our Cloudflare Edge Worker monitors pending transactions automatically. You can also trigger immediate verification at any time via the "Refresh Credits" button on the Transactions page.
